message:
The libraries were built without ASan (the scons build was interrupted). Let me check if the libraries have ASan symbols, and also check if the build actually completed with ASan. Let me check the timestamps and try a different approach - build just the needed objects directly:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpsd && ls -la gpsd-3.25.1~dev/gpsd/packet.o gpsd-3.25.1~dev/gpsd/crc24q.o 2>&1 && nm gpsd-3.25.1~dev/gpsd/packet.o | grep -c "__asan" 2>&1</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
